description: List data categories that group related data types — Temperature, Precipitation, Wind, Pressure, Sunshine, Sky cover, Weather Type, and more. Use to discover what types of measurements are available before calling noaa_climate_list_data_types. Optionally filter by dataset, location, station, or date range. There are 42 categories in total.

datasetId.description: Filter to categories available in this dataset (e.g., "GHCND", "GSOM"). Optional.

endDate.description: Filter to categories with data on or before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–1000). Defaults to 25.

locationId.description: Filter to categories available at this location ID. Optional.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first result to return for pagination. Defaults to 0.

sortField.description: Sort results by this field. Optional.

sortOrder.description: Sort direction. Optional; defaults to asc.

startDate.description: Filter to categories with data on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional.

stationId.description: Filter to categories available at this station ID. Optional.

name: noaa_climate_list_data_categories

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `service_unavailable`: NOAA CDO API is unreachable or returning errors. `rate_limited`: NOAA CDO throttled the request — the configured token went over its rate limit. `upstream_auth_failed`: NOAA CDO rejected the API token this server is configured with. `validation_error`: A filter parameter is not recognized by the NOAA CDO API (e.g., unknown datasetId). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exhausted.description: True when the requested offset is past the end of a non-empty result set — the page is empty but matches exist. Omitted otherwise.

metadata.description: Pagination metadata. Present when the API returns it.

resultset.description: Pagination cursor fields for this response.

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

offset.description: Zero-based starting index of this page, echoing the requested offset.

notice.description: Guidance when no data categories matched — echoes applied filters and suggests how to broaden.

id.description: Data category ID (e.g., TEMP, PRCP, WIND).

totalCount.description: Total number of matching data categories before the page limit.

title: List NOAA Climate Data Categories
